feature: PATCH_010: v2.2.0 baseline release (four-product audit). License unified to the MIT License (copyright ACE Comprehensive Consulting Co., Ltd.); LICENSE.txt and the License window now match the AZRAS-System repository LICENSE; dev_checks/license_consistency_self_check.py added.
